string.text: A welded steel range on a brick plinth, with a chimney, a prep shelf and a firewood rack. The Cook works here: it counts as a stove, so the Cook makes full meals instead of campfire food (with stove fuel in camp storage when the MCM fuel rule is on). Use it to open its storage: 300 kg of settlement storage for food and drink. Weighs 30 kg to carry.

A medical corner with an instrument stand, drip and supplies. The Medic works here: it counts as a medical station. Use it to open its storage: 300 kg of settlement storage for medicine. Weighs 28 kg to carry.

A sentry table with a logbook and a rack for the watch. Guards stand watch here first, before the barricades and turrets. Use it to open its storage: 300 kg of settlement storage for weapons, ammo and grenades. Weighs 26 kg to carry.

A sorting table for what the scavengers drag home. Scavengers wait here between expeditions. Use it to open its storage: 300 kg of settlement storage for tools, parts and salvage. Weighs 24 kg to carry.
